headline: Burkina Faso built from the 2023 official CGI (LF 2024 and LFR 2024 checked, LF 2025 not reached): monthly IUTS 0-25 % after a 25 % (20 % for higher grades) abattement, a family reduction of 8-14 % of the tax, 50 %-abated rents at 18/25 %, IRCM 12,5 %, CNSS 5,5 %.
